body:
Closes the last named gap in CarePyre's Community Tools resume feature: internal/resume/pdf.go's RenderPDF (github.com/go-pdf/fpdf, pure Go, no cgo) renders a real, plain, single-column, selectable-text PDF -- not an image, not just a screen preview. Two new routes: GET /api/v1/community-tools/resume/export.pdf (master) and GET /api/v1/community-tools/resume/targets/{id}/export.pdf (a resolved Target), both community-tools.access-gated, served through a shared writeResumePDF helper. Found and fixed a real header-injection risk before it shipped: a Target's own user-controlled Name field going straight into the Content-Disposition header -- closed with pdfFilename, a narrow allowlist sanitizer. 16 Go tests (3 pdf_test.go + 13 handler tests incl. a header-injection regression check using a target literally named Kitchen Jobs "Special"), full suite green. Live-verified end to end against a real, fresh-SQLite-booted idunapro binary (register -> flip is_community_tools_enabled -> login -> save resume -> GET export.pdf returns a real, file(1)-confirmed PDF with correct headers), including the quoted-name case live, not just in unit tests. Added real 'Download PDF' (Preview & templates card) and per-Target 'Export PDF' buttons to CarePyre's console.html, fetching via authHeaders() as a blob (a plain <a href> can't carry the bearer token) and triggering a real browser download using the server's own Content-Disposition filename. Docs updated: CarePyre/docs/COMMUNITY_TOOLS_RESUME_NORTHSTAR.md new section 4d, section 5 gaps list corrected, both repos' CLAUDE.md Status sections updated.

⚓ ☃
title: Community Tools: real, downloadable ATS-safe PDF export (Layer 3)
